Rules / Formatting

SK0216 The argument naming style is not arranged

skala arrange would add or remove argument names under the configured style.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

Adding a name requires the resolved parameter; removing one is safe only when the argument already occupies that parameter's position. The rule binds the selected overload and preserves names that carry ordering semantics.

Example

Instead of:

Move(x: 1, y: 2);

Write:

Move(1, 2);

When it does not fire

Unresolved calls, out-of-position arguments and expanded params arguments that cannot legally be named are left alone.

Configuration

  • skala_arguments_literal
  • skala_arguments_string_literal
  • skala_arguments_anonymous_function
  • skala_arguments_named
  • skala_arguments_other
  • skala_arguments_skip_single
